rows.label: tlk70000033_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Are you going to defeat Heaven's Holy
Grail now, mo? Is there anything
Momimi can do to help, mo?

rows.label: tlk70000033_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Momimi has to go back to
Pignerator Trade Guild HQ, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000033_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Sadly, we'll have to say goodbye soon,
mo...

rows.label: tlk70000033_05_msg0004
rows.name:
...But Momimi had so much fun coming
to this city in Iira, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000033_05_msg0005
rows.name:
Momimi loves this city, where Iirans,
Nopon, and Blades are all kind to each
other, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000033_05_msg0006
rows.name:
That's why Momimi will definitely come
back to this city one day, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000033_05_msg0007
rows.name:
And Momimi believes we'll meet again
when that day comes, mo!
